name: terreno-plugins
description: Public marketplace for Terreno: agentic SDLC planning and execution plugins.

plugins.name: terreno
plugins.description: Terreno lifecycle (Grow, Pick/Roast, Brew, Taste), goal-driven scans (Aim, Sweep, Sift, Plot, Track), app-building, documentation, deployment, and verification workflows.

plugins.name: bundles
plugins.description: One skill per bundle: lifecycle, scan, app, ship, design, dx. Each carries its member skills as references.

plugins.name: terreno-lifecycle
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. PRD seed, then bounded Grow → Pick ⇄ Roast → Brew → Taste, plus the Pick-Roast, planning, and taste-sweep outer loops.

plugins.name: terreno-scan
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. Charter a measurable long-term goal, map-reduce the repository into findings (Aim → Sweep → Sift → Plot → Track), and drive each slice to a PR.

plugins.name: terreno-app
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. Backend, UI, light/dark mode, data, schema, admin, and test conventions for building Terreno apps.

plugins.name: terreno-ship
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. UI verification, PR evidence, docs, releases, upgrades, store assets, and GCP deploys.

plugins.name: terreno-design
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. Turn a Claude design into a Terreno implementation plan and Linear work.

plugins.name: terreno-dx
plugins.description: Subset of the terreno plugin. Debug a running app over MCP, set up and write backend, frontend, and mobile tests, backfill regression suites and user guides, and wire social login and MCP servers.
